items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: But I told my cousin Warnick that the old man will fit this Pajou's place will be Peter Bocard.

ctx.x: Calliope, he can play that. Because I say, yeah. Well, he played with P. Roy and all of them. See? Now, of course, this fellow, yeah, they tell me, I ain't seen him yet. But I told my cousin Warnick that the old man will fit this Pajou's place will be Peter Bocard. And they tell me he's in the band.
Yeah, he's been playing with the Urican.

items.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: his brother Louis lived around on Perth Street now

ctx.x: Tell them about what they used to call you. You remember we were talking about how people get your name confused?

Oh yeah, well you see, Keppert was kind of a little cousin of mine, you know. Well they used to call me Freddy Keppert. Oh really? Yeah, his brother Louis lived around on Perth Street now, you see, and they say, well that's my cousin, you see, well they call, they call him, call me Freddy Keppert. And everywhere I went people used to call me Freddy Keppert.
Did you look like him some too? Well I looked just that much. He looked that awfully heavy at first before he died, I never saw him.
